g.text: Target and budget change the rule comparison

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5661

g.text: All nine metals and 31 budgets; each target uses its own chemical oracle.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48545f

g.text: Colors classify the comparison, not retention magnitude. All cutoff-tie choices are included.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48545f

g.text: Better means the rule's minimum exceeds the other rule's maximum by more than 10⁻¹².

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48545f

g.text: Ranges are not confidence intervals. Budgets are dependent descriptive comparisons.
